methods.name: FEGLM: Gaussian coefficients pinned to fixest; convergence reporting for logit, probit, Poisson
methods.reference: fixest::feglm(| id + time, vcov = 'iid'); stats::glm with factor dummies
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 480: coefficients 1e-8 relative; df and n exact. MAP exact after 2 sweeps on this design

deviations.quantity: logit_coef, probit_coef, poisson_coef, gauss_se_lm, gauss_deviance, gauss_dispersion
deviations.note: the fixed effects are recovered in eta in one pass, not iterated to the fixed point of the weighted problem; fixest also drops the 16 rows of entities whose binary outcome is constant (logit_nobs 464 of 480)
the Gaussian log-likelihood (and AIC/BIC) is -0.5 SSR, not glm's normal log-likelihood
the Poisson SEs are scaled by a quasi-Poisson dispersion

deviations.quantity: df_resid, df_absorbed on disconnected two-way designs
deviations.note: feglm keeps its own absorbed-df rule (levels summed minus n_factors - 1), which over-counts on disconnected fixed effects; feglm_families is connected, so its df are unaffected
